result.title: REVEAL: Reconstructing Video Amodal Content via Language and Flow Guidance
result.comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
result.summary: Amodal perception enables humans to perceive entire objects even when parts are occluded, a remarkable cognitive skill that artificial intelligence struggles to replicate. Recent diffusion-based methods have extended amodal completion from images to videos, yet they lack auxiliary priors to guide the reconstruction of heavily occluded content and to maintain temporal consistency over long sequences. We present REVEAL (REconstructing VidEo Amodal content via Language and flow guidance), a unified diffusion-based framework that integrates complementary motion and semantic priors for video amodal completion. A user-provided text query serves a dual role: it drives open-vocabulary video segmentation to obtain visible masks, and it provides semantic guidance for texture reconstruction. For amodal segmentation, we introduce optical flow guidance: by warping visible masks from previous frames to the current frame, the flow-warped mask propagates visible content into occluded regions and approximates the object's current shape, providing a strong shape prior even under simultaneous deformation and occlusion. For texture completion, text guidance constrains the reconstruction of occluded appearance while providing a stable semantic reference that helps maintain visual coherence throughout the reconstruction. We also contribute LAVAT, a new benchmark featuring long video sequences paired with text descriptions, enabling evaluation of text-guided video amodal completion under heavy occlusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REVEAL achieves state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks while maintaining high-quality temporal consistency over extended sequences. The project page is available at: https://uark-aicv.github.io/REVEAL/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 REVEAL，一个结合光流运动先验与文本语义先验的扩散式视频非模态补全框架，用流扭曲历史可见掩码预测遮挡形状、用文本约束遮挡区域纹理重建，并发布长视频文本配对基准 LAVAT。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把前帧可见内容经光流扭曲传播到遮挡区作为形状先验」的机制，或可类比 LVR 中视觉证据的跨步携带与遮挡下细节保留策略，但论文面向补全生成而非推理，迁移性需核查。
